objective: Evaluate transfer of the locked adiabatic real-gas vessel-discharge model to an independent KIT small-reservoir pressure-decay trace.
claim_boundary: One 20 MPa, 0.37 L, 4 mm pressure-decay trace; no flame, ignition, dispersion, radiation, station control or safety-distance claim.

source.title: Experimental study of ignited unsteady hydrogen releases from a high pressure reservoir
source.experimental_institution: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology HYKA/HPHR facility
source.target: Figure 2 measured reservoir pressure decay for the 4 mm, 200 bar release
source.publisher_pdf_redistribution: prohibited; retain source citation and derived coordinates with extraction metadata only

known_before_freeze.qualitative_article_claim: The prose states that a Saint-Venant-Wantzel efflux relation with a linear nozzle form factor can describe the vessel pressure decay.
known_before_freeze.blinding_limit: Bibliographic metadata, apparatus description and the qualitative article claim were known; the test is prospectively numeric but not fully blinded.

locked_model.description: Well-mixed adiabatic rigid vessel with HEOS hydrogen properties and maximum real-gas isentropic flux through a 4 mm aperture; Cd=0.8 fixed from the existing twin; no outcome fitting.
locked_model.initial_pressure_basis: 20 MPa absolute primary; a +101.325 kPa gauge-to-absolute sensitivity may be reported separately and cannot replace the primary result

requires: finite positive measured absolute reservoir pressure
measured Figure 2 curve only, without substituting the paper's calculated curve
documented digitization method and source checksum
eligibility.insufficient_data_policy: Archive an ineligible result without extrapolation or substituting the published calculation.

median_absolute_percentage_error_percent.support: measured pressure at least 10 percent of initial measured pressure

aggregate_decision.claim_supported: all three primary endpoint screens pass
aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: Any failed screen remains archived and prohibits a pressure-decay validation claim from this dataset.
